Бур на метеорите

A resource site built around a drill and three lever rooms.

Что делать

Start all three levers within 10-second intervals. Use room lights to find failures and repair a lever within 30 seconds.

Награды

The drill runs for 3 minutes, producing HQM and stone, then cools down for 15 minutes; traders are nearby.

Риски

The sequence keeps you on site, so watch for other players and environmental hazards.

Recycler

For recycling, visit a gas station, parking lot, town, warehouse, Lumberjack or Miner.
